version_boundary: Fixed upstream is Minecraft1.21.1, NeoForge21.1.162. No Dynasty Forge1.20.1 source/ABI/native compatibility claim.

new_observations.server_replace: AnimationHandler.sendAnimationMessage returns on client. Server immediately calls entity.setAnimation then sends only entityId and index to tracking players/self. In MowzieLLibrary setter, any new animation resets animationTick0; onAnimationFinish only called for replacement with NO_ANIMATION, not every direct transition.
new_observations.client_replace: AnimationMessage enqueues lookup, sets NO_ANIMATION for index-1 or selected array entry, then resets tick0. No old-pose/time or blend snapshot in payload. Spawn packet remains separate index+currentTick as earlier recorded; not a world reload guarantee.
new_observations.generic_handler_boundary: Generic updateAnimations also contains start/tick events and looping-duration code. It was read completely but no actual Frostmaw call path to it established. Confirmed entity uses its own increment/client-end path. Do not add generic handler increment to entity tick and claim doubled timing.
new_observations.ordinary_damage: Frostmaw constructor sets playsHurtAnimation=false. Successful nonlethal ordinary damage while already active does not by the selected parent hurt path request hurt animation; not an automatic wake interruption. Fall/arrow handling and other paths have their own conditions.
new_observations.fatal_damage: Parent hurt requests DIE when successful health<=0. Frostmaw override prevents wake request from replacing DIE. Old activate goal stop skips NO_ANIMATION if current animation no longer matches. Death goal has interruptsAI=false, so do not infer MOVE/LOOK suppression from its presence alone. Public active assignments differ from synced ACTIVE as prior.
new_observations.deactivation_damage: Inactive synced ACTIVE during deactivation allows selected nonfatal successful hurt path to send ACTIVATE then setActive(true), unless death/peaceful. It does not resume saved deactivation progress. Old deactivate stop can set public active=false after superclass condition skipped clearing new activation; getActive later reloads public field from synced ACTIVE. Exact scheduler/public-field observation order not certified.
new_observations.reset_boundary: BasicModelBase registers all constructor parts; AdvancedModelBase iterates them for reset. AdvancedModelRenderer reset restores positions/rotations only, not scales/scaleChildren/showModel. Chest/backHair breath scales set only in inactive branch in selected model, so activation output depends on prior model-render scale history. No assertion this is a native bug or author intent error.
new_observations.hierarchy: 85 declared and constructed rigid model parts,74 declared addBox calls including zero-sized holders/planes. Independent field set equals constructor set, parent chains acyclic for head/jaw/hands/feet. Accessory crystal nodes excluded from diagram/geometry landmarks. No weighted skin invented.
new_observations.render_math: ModelBox expands corners using inflate, mirror affects winding not extrema; positions/vertices scaled by1/16 at render. Basic translateRotate is translation then Z,Y,X. Advanced renderer cancels parent scale before child local transform when scaleChildren=false (default); own scale remains. Thumb constructor overrides πY/Z4 and small hand/finger scales included.
new_observations.contact_bound: Nine bounded poses measured against model Y24 only, with cached terrain heights0 and explicit chest carry. Sleeping0 core head gap14.51756, jaw.43257,leftFoot-1.21632,rightFoot-.51248 model units. Distinguish skull/jaw/sole and opaque fur/plane extents. Mixed positive/negative gaps are not a proven game defect, head-ground constraint or accepted contact policy.
new_observations.conditional_replacement: New conditional landmark comparison includes wake36→death0 and deactivation10→activate0, fresh tick0 assumptions, zero look/gait/terrain. HeadJoint origin changes16.75070 and9.76366 model units respectively.
